text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Laaalaaa! Happy birthdaaay! I've got a 
present ready for you too!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It's a scrunchie for your tail! The one 
with the white flower pattern! You love 
flowers, right, Lala? It's gonna look so 
good on you!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank—huh? Wait, I feel like I saw 
something similar yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It was there when we went 
out together! Hehehe, I secretly bought it 
back then!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—! ...I was just looking at that 
yesterday. Thank you so much, Blast-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Man, I was totally eyeing that one! It 
was so cute I felt a bit intimidated, but 
if Blast-san says so... it's worth a 
shot!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Boo likes this scrunchie too! The 
flower and the colors are super cute, 
aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Huh...—Yeah, you're right. Thanks a ton, 
really. I can't wait to wear it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...This kinda thing happens every now and 
then. It's like she can read my mind with 
how kind she's bein'.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It'd be embarrassing with any other girl, 
but...\n...What is it about her, I 
wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Then Boo will bring her tail scrunchie 
tomorrow too! Let's show each other ours, 
Lala!
